question.prompt: The area of a pizza with radius \(4\) inches is \(N\) percent larger than the area of a pizza with radius \(3\) inches. What is the integer closest to \(N?\)

solutions.title: Find the percentage increase
solutions.explanation:
The smaller pizza provides the reference area for the percentage increase. Using the circle area formula \(A=\pi r^2\), the two areas are \(9\pi\) and \(16\pi\) square inches.

The increase is \(16\pi-9\pi=7\pi\), so
\[
N=\frac{7\pi}{9\pi}\cdot100=\frac{700}{9}=77.777\ldots.
\]
The nearest integer is \(\boxed{78}\), choice \(\text{E}\).
